div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 专项合规与质量检查器

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
存在任意 1 项阻断性违规
(极限词 / 违规功效 / 关键必填参数缺失)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
无阻断项, 但存在待核实证书编号
或任一检查器调用失败 (fallback_used==True)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 无阻断项 且 无待人工核实/降级项

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 可选联动: 提取该商品高频争议点

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 运营上传商品详情页 PDF + 申报上架类目 declared_category

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
upload_to_minio 节点:
真实写入 MinIO ecomops-docs 桶
记录 pdf_minio_path

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
download_pdf 节点:
读取 PDF 字节流

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
extract_text 节点:
PyMuPDF 提取文本并处理双栏阅读顺序
(仅作文本级审查, 不承诺视觉首屏排版美学打分)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
extract_structured 节点:
抽取商品标题、核心参数表、功效宣称、证书编号列表

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: run_compliance_checks 节点 (asyncio.gather 并发执行专项检查)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
检查器 1：广告法违禁极限词扫描
(规则词库 + LLM 上下文复核)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
检查器 2：申报类目必填参数完整度核查
(对照 declared_category 必填属性表)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
检查器 3：医疗/虚假功效宣称排查
(如洗发水防脱生发、水果治病等)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
检查器 4：资质与检测报告编号提取
(3C编号/化妆品备案号/质检报告号)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 检查器 5：卖点可读性与文案优化建议

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
diagnose_and_classify 节点:
汇总各检查器结果与异常降级标志 fallback_used

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
三层合规门禁判定逻辑
(严禁用加权总分抵消违规项!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
结论: REJECTED_BLOCKING (一票否决)
输出第一层: blocking_violations 强制整改清单

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
结论: PENDING_MANUAL_VERIFY (转人工核验)
输出第二层: manual_verify_items (严禁拿默认分直接当通过!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
结论: PASSED_WITH_SUGGESTIONS (审查通过)
输出第三层: advisory_suggestions 文案优化建议

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
save_results 节点:
持久化三层结构化报告至 PostgreSQL listing_reviews 表

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
生成客服演练场景种子卡 training_scenario_seed
(供客服进入 cs_training 开展多轮人工对练)
